> **Re-scoped 2026-11-19** — results now show rendered artifacts and replay, not code metrics. See the pivot notice at the top of `REQUIREMENTS.md`.

Dependencies: `F18`, `F5`

Display the round outcome: the three rendered artifacts side by side, playback of each model's code and frames, the per-model conformance verdict with the judge's reasons, why each model forfeited (if any), the crowd's fan-favorite result, and final odds vs. outcome.

Acceptance criteria:

- Results distinguish winner, tie, forfeit, judge-unavailable and void states.
- Generated code is presented safely and **does not execute in the browser** outside the quarantine rules (iframe `allow-scripts`, never `allow-same-origin`, CSP `connect-src 'none'`, no origin/cookie access).
- Users can understand why each model won, failed or forfeited without reading code.

Source: `REQUIREMENTS.md`
